name: Aurora Prism Butterfly Grove
description: A grove where butterflies' wings are prisms, scattering aurora colors as they flutter among glowing flowers.
prompt: Enchanted grove with butterflies possessing crystalline wings that refract light into vibrant aurora hues, surrounding flowers emitting soft bioluminescence, night sky alive with dancing colors, ethereal lighting.
caption: Butterflies that paint the air with rainbow auroras—magic in motion. 🦋🌈
